_doc: E0.3 design decisions, FROZEN 2026-09-18 before any stage-2 result existed. Options, evidence and consequences: PROTOCOL.md, 'E0.3 decisions required before controls'. Validate: python phase0/e03_decisions.py check phase0/e03_decisions.json
_pool: D1: the 16,646,992 rows that already carry a paper CometKiwi score. Reproduces the paper's selection (top-1M band 0.8959-0.9145), so ft_topk vs ft_random stays a quality contrast instead of a domain-and-novelty one.
_heldout_domains: D3+D4: Europarl is dropped because every candidate pair (2000/2000) is already in the v1.1 pretraining corpus; recorded as a pre-registered deviation.
_lr: D6: flat-slope with a 0.3 BLEU tolerance. The old default (no strict monotone decline) selects lr_scale 1.0 even on a 29.9 -> 29.0 decline, and 1.0 is the setting under suspicion. Base matched-step seed sd on newstest2013 was 0.05-0.14 BLEU.
_score_mode: D7: score all 38,275,284 rows with today's stack, then calibrate against the paper's reused scores. The FT pool stays the reused population, so selection uses one uniform scoring run and the old/new drift is measured rather than mixed in. ~17.5 GPU-h on the box's own RTX 5090.
_calibration: D7b: thresholds are the 2026-09-13 audit's proposals and may NOT be changed after a failed calibration. jaccard_min_k 500 keeps small groups (giga-fren has 4,351 reused rows) reported but not gating.
_ft_checkpoint: D8: the baseline is an averaged release, so averaging the fine-tuned runs is the like-for-like comparison.
_budget: D9: step-matched arms, spike guard off (PROTOCOL 1.3) so dropped batches cannot differ by condition.
